Name: Shobi, Son of Nahash
Summary: Shobi, son of Nahash of Rabbah, was among those who brought beds, basins, and food to David and his people at Mahanaim during Absalom's revolt.
KeyStory: Shobi of Rabbah fed David's exhausted people at Mahanaim.
RelatedPeople: King David; Barzillai the Gileadite; Machir, Son of Ammiel
LifeLesson: An Ammonite's son fed Israel's king — kindness crosses old borders.
